messages:
elaine-partners: Quick sync — we need to lock down packaging for AWS/GCP/Azure listings this week. Who can take ownership of bundle SKUs, trial terms, and the legal artifact list? @alex-legal @mike-product @indra-ops @ben-aws

alex-legal: I can own legal artifacts. Need final EULA & privacy pointer, and confirmation whether we use our standard SaaS T&Cs or a marketplace-specific addendum. Also note Azure needs publisher agreement signed before storefront preview.

mike-product: Proposing two bundles: 1) Starter (self-serve, 2 vCPU equiv, 14-day trial) 2) Enterprise (dedicated capacity + SSO + support). Should we include a metered vs fixed pricing option?

indra-ops: From ops side we need SKU entitlement mapping for trial gating and a service account to push test images. Also flagging telemetry (opt-in) and billing tags to make allowed.

ben-aws: Happy to validate on AWS staging. I can run the manifest through the publisher portal and check AMI/container metadata. Staging link: https://aws-staging-pub.example.com (use test-org). IAM needed: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplacePublisherTestRole

elaine-partners: OK I'll put together a draft manifest + FAQ and assign tasks. Draft snippet to start (manifest keys we need):
```
name: redwood-inference
bundles:
  - id: starter
    short_name: Starter
    trial_days: 14
  - id: enterprise
    short_name: Enterprise
    support: premium
```
I'll upload full doc to the partnership drive and tag everyone.

marketplace-bot: Created ticket #MKP-4821 for "marketplace manifest + legal artifacts" and added due date 2024-02-14.

ashley-aws-ps: Can join a 20min call tomorrow 9:30am PT to validate staging flow end-to-end. If that works I'll invite the AWS validation engineer. :thumbsup:
